observations: Photo 0 shows a large industrial machine with teal/white body, multiple rollers/frames, and a control area; looks like a printing/packaging-related press.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from another angle with a control panel (buttons/emergency stop) and a feed/roller section; no clear brand/model text readable.

claims.evidence: No photo/video shows it running, no display/diagnostics, no output sample, and no close-up of any model/serial plate.

risks.risk: Exact machine type/model is not readable, so compatibility, parts availability, and correct market pricing are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/serial/model label (usually on the side/front) and the full control panel labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic industrial press/printing-related machine with unknown specs and assume not fully proven for the buyer’s intended job.

risks.risk: “Perfect working condition” is not verifiable remotely without a running test (mechanical, electrical, and calibration).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the machine starting, running through a full cycle, and producing a sample output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst case: needs service/adjustment) rather than fully working.

risks.risk: Potential hidden wear/damage (rollers, belts, gears, bearings) that photos can’t confirm.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wear points: rollers/bearings, belts/chains, and any visible oil leaks or cracks; plus a running sound check in video.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming wear may require maintenance.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables/tools (dies, guides, spare parts, manuals) that affect real usability.
risks.proof: Inventory photo list of included items (dies/rollers/attachments), and what is not included.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the machine nameplate/serial/model label (front/side) and any electrical specs label.
Video of the machine running a full cycle and producing a sample output (show start-up, operation, and end).
Close-ups of rollers/belts/chains/bearings and any oil/leak/crack areas.
List of included accessories (dies/attachments/manuals/spares) and what’s missing.
response.reason: The photos show an industrial press/printing-related machine, but the exact model/type and working status cannot be confirmed. Without a running test and readable identification, pricing would be guesswork.
